newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa's Mandela says he fighting fit.
newsitem.headline: South Africa's Mandela says he fighting fit.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela, 78, said on Monday he was in good health and challenged a reporter to a boxing match to prove the point.
Mandela cancelled an official appointment on Friday and set aside several days to rest ahead of a visit to the Indian sub- continent.
The president on Monday had a 30-minute meeting with Diana, Princess of Wales, and reporters asked him afterwards about his health.
"My health is fine. Do you want to challenge me?" he asked, raising his fists to spar. Mandela was a keen amateur boxer in his youth.
Last year unsubstantiated rumours about his health sent the rand into a slide against the dollar and other major currencies. The currency has since recovered some of its sharp losses.
